stepExplanation:
Of the 12 G3P molecules produced:
- **2 G3P** molecules (containing 6 carbons total) exit to form 1 glucose molecule (C6H12O6)
- **10 G3P** molecules are recycled to regenerate RuBP (the 5-carbon acceptor molecule)

This ensures the cycle can continue capturing more CO2.
stepBody: If 2 G3P molecules are used to make one glucose molecule, how many of the 12 G3P molecules are used to regenerate RuBP?
